description: Hours in the temperature range the source describes as favourable for late blight, with rain (leaf-wetness proxy).

citation.quote: The disease spreads rapidly under cool, wet, and humid weather, particularly when temperatures range from 60 to 78 degrees Fahrenheit with extended periods of leaf wetness.

interpretation_notes: 60-78 °F converted to 15.6-25.6 °C. 'Leaf wetness' is approximated by hourly precipitation > 0 mm because the source gives no numeric humidity or wetness-duration threshold. 'Extended periods' is not quantified in the source, so any single matching hour is reported (with the count) instead of an invented duration.
